summary: Automatic redraw: windows track the views their last frame rendered; Notify on a rendered view marks the window dirty and wakes it; Window.Refresh, Window.OnNextFrame, Context.OnNextFrame, RequestAnimationFrame (notify rendering view next frame), RefreshWindows; WM_PAINT runs the pinned frame request (next-frame callbacks, draw if dirty, present hook); wakes pace on DwmFlush then InvalidateRect; resize refreshes.
deviations: auto-redraw is opt-in: real windows redraw automatically only when OnRedraw (now the present step) is set; test apps only after TestApp.SetFrameLoop(true) — upstream always redraws; kept so existing manual-redraw corpora (authorspec counter, assetspec/svgspec RefreshRequested asserts) stay valid. Follow-up ticket 33 makes it the default
dirty tracking covers rendered views (not every entity read during a frame); a notify during a draw still reaches observers (upstream drops it)
pacing waits for vblank only while a wake is pending; no inactive/thermal throttling
